title: Amazon.com Inc. Acquires Technology Company Shoefitr
summary: Amazon.com Inc. has acquired Shoefitr, a Pittsburgh-based company specializing in 3D technology that matches online shoppers with best-fitting shoes. This acquisition aims to reduce the guesswork in buying footwear online and potentially decrease shoe returns significantly for Amazon. Shoefitr's technology scans shoes and compares them to a user's current pair to recommend the best size and style, addressing the issue of inconsistent shoe sizing in the industry.

title: Apple Inc. (AAPL), Amazon.com, Inc. (AMZN), Google Inc (GOOGL) & Microsoft Corporation (MSFT): 4 Horsemen Of NASDAQ
summary: This article discusses the performance of four major tech companies—Apple, Amazon, Google, and Microsoft—dubbed the "4 Horsemen of NASDAQ," in early 2015. Amazon showed the most significant growth with over 45% YTD, followed by Apple and Google, while Microsoft had more modest gains. Analysts James Cakmak and Jason Helfstein weighed in on Amazon's impressive turnaround, particularly highlighting its web services business.

title: ESPN sues Verizon over unbundled sports channel
summary: ESPN is suing Verizon for allegedly breaching its contract by unbundling the sports channel from its main FiOS TV programming lineup. Verizon's new discounted "custom TV" package allows subscribers to opt out of ESPN, which the sports channel claims violates a contractual requirement for its inclusion in the main bundle. This legal battle highlights the pressure pay-TV providers face to offer cheaper, more flexible choices amid increasing competition from online streaming services.

title: With $170M pending acquisition of Apartment Finder, CoStar Group makes another massive rental play
summary: CoStar Group, parent company of Apartments.com, is set to acquire Apartment Finder for $170 million, further expanding its presence in the rental market. It plans to operate both brands separately while unifying their listing databases to offer landlords more exposure and effectively target leads. This acquisition intensifies competition in the digital rental space, where CoStar is investing significantly in marketing to challenge established players and startups alike.
